title: What Should Stay Private?
style: calm luminous storybook watercolor with clear cutaway mechanisms

pages.text: Private means something not everyone needs to know. Ask a grown-up you trust before sharing it.

quickWords.th: เป็นส่วนตัว
ส่งต่อให้ผู้อื่นเห็น

pages.text: Your password, home address, school details, and where you are right now are private.

quickWords.th: ที่อยู่บ้าน

pages.text: A photo can show a face, uniform, or location. Ask permission before sharing a photo of another person.
A password helps protect an account. Keep it private, and ask your trusted adult if you need help with it.
A trusted grown-up might be a parent, caregiver, or teacher. Choose someone who listens and helps.

quickWords.th: ผู้ใหญ่ที่ไว้ใจ

pages.text: A drawing can be fun to share. Ask a grown-up you trust to check it with you first.
Before you share anything online, ask a trusted adult. If something worries or confuses you, ask for help.

quickWords.th: แชร์ / ส่งต่อให้ผู้อื่นเห็น
ผู้ใหญ่ที่ไว้ใจ

pages.text: Private information needs care. Can you name two trusted adults you can ask for help?

quickWords.th: ข้อมูลส่วนตัว
ผู้ใหญ่ที่ไว้ใจ
